title: Feeling Fabulous !
body: it's only been day three for me using Fabulous app and I already feel fabulous I feel really good mentally and physically. I never did a morning routine but now as I started to use Fabulous app everything in life makes more sense I have been doing yoga and drinking water as soon as I wake up and is helping me a lot to focus on my day, then in the evening I have another schedule where I eat fruits and vegetables and then exercise a little bit and then start to study for 45 min. My life had never been more in line I'm going to use this app forever. I just recommend it to all the people that are going through hard stuff in life and for the people who have a messy day. Enjoy !!!! ☺️
